$comment: The atomic, reusable classes defined in src/index.css @layer components/utilities, plus the one shared React atom (Arrow). A primitive is something with no content of its own; anything that knows what it says is a component or a section.

shell.css: .shell { @apply mx-auto w-full px-5 md:px-8; max-width: calc(1216px + 64px); }
shell.usage: Wraps the content column of nearly every section. Full-bleed sections (SystemBand video, CTA photo) deliberately sit outside it.
shell.rationale: Content must run 32..1248 at 1280 (1216 wide). max-w-[1216px]+px-8 would give 1152 wide, 32px off-axis.

display-hero.rationale: 76px drops to the 48px step below md on the original — a hard swap, NOT fluid type. Do not replace with clamp().

eyebrow.usage: Small mono kicker above a heading.

eyebrow-tight.usage: Footer headings and the CTA eyebrow.
eyebrow-tight.rationale: Only the copyright line carries tracking; these measure letter-spacing:normal on the original.

btn.css: .btn { @apply inline-flex items-center justify-center whitespace-nowrap rounded-full font-display transition-all duration-150 ease-out active:scale-[0.98]; }
btn.usage: Base for all pill actions; never used bare.

btn-light.css: .btn-light { @apply btn h-10 gap-1.5 bg-cream pl-5 pr-4 text-[16px] leading-6 text-ink hover:bg-white; letter-spacing: normal; }
btn-light.usage: Primary CTA on ink surfaces (home hero, product hero).
btn-light.rationale: h40 with asymmetric padding (20 lead / 16 trail) because the trailing arrow carries its own 6px right padding. 16/24 at letter-spacing normal, NOT -0.16.

btn-mint.css: .btn-mint { @apply btn h-10 gap-1.5 bg-mint pl-5 pr-4 text-[16px] leading-6 text-ink hover:brightness-105; letter-spacing: normal; }
btn-mint.usage: Primary CTA in the conversion band and the contact form submit.

btn-ghost.css: .btn-ghost { @apply btn border border-white/25 px-5 py-2.5 text-label text-cream hover:border-white/50 hover:bg-white/5; }

btn-arrow.css: .btn-arrow { @apply inline-block h-2 w-[11px] shrink-0; margin-left: -1.5px; margin-right: -1.5px; }
btn-arrow.geometry: 11x8 chevron, viewBox 0 0 11 8, stroke currentColor 1.2, round caps/joins
btn-arrow.rationale: The arrow occupies a 16px box with 6px trailing padding, adding 22px total — not 11px plus the flex gap, which overshot the pill by 8px. The negative margins are load-bearing.

marquee-track.css: .marquee-track { display:flex; width:max-content; animation: marquee 40s linear infinite; } .marquee-track:hover { animation-play-state: paused; }
marquee-track.rationale: Requires the track to contain two identical halves so -50% lands exactly on the seam.

reveal.css: .reveal { opacity:0; transform: translateY(24px); transition: opacity .7s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), transform .7s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .reveal.is-visible { opacity:1; transform:none; }
reveal.usage: Add the class to any element that should rise in on scroll. The Layout observer picks it up automatically per route.
reveal.contract: Observer fires once (unobserve on intersect) and re-queries on every pathname change.

rules: Never hardcode a hex that already exists in tokens.json — reference the Tailwind token name.
Pill actions always come from a btn-* variant; do not compose a new one inline.
Any pill with a trailing arrow uses <Arrow />, never an inline SVG copy — the negative margins are tuned.
Decimal pixel values in this design are measurements from the original, not mistakes. Do not round them.
